subject: Operational resume demonstration - RPO sampling & evidence

Cc: ops@latticepay.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: operational resume demonstration and RPO sampling evidence

Camila —

Thanks again for the SOC2 intake call last week. As part of our internal acceptance we need a short operational resume demonstration showing RPO sampling and the artifacts you’d supply for a post-incident verification. Our security team would like to witness the evidence and ask a few focused questions about how RPO is measured for warm cache and KV restore sequences.

Can your team run a 30–45 minute session next week (UTC-7 morning preferred) to: 
- Walk through the RPO sampling methodology you use (how you select keys, time windows, sampling cadence)
- Show a small live restore from warm cache + timing profile
- Provide the logs/artifacts we need for our auditor (CSV manifest, timestamps, and a replayable trace)

Attaching our intake checklist and a short list of fields we need in the manifest — if you can confirm what you’ll deliver and suggested times, we’ll lock in the session and invite our auditor (Mark).

Attachments: lattice-intake-checklist.pdf, required-manifest-fields.txt

Appreciate it —
Susan Liu
Principal Information Security
LatticePay
